compute/fit the pure-stress degree-14 coefficient map

headline_question: Does degree 14 contain any genuinely new obstruction generator modulo prolongations of the lower all-orders ideal?
claim_boundary: A zero degree-14 quotient is evidence of stabilization, not an all-orders finite-generation proof.
